title: Micheal Clemons agrees to terms with the Colts

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Micheal Clemons agrees to terms with the Colts
sources.description: The Colts have added defensive lineman Micheal Clemons, who agreed to a three-year, $17.5 million deal, according to Jordan Schultz of The Schultz Report.
